world_state: Repeated unidentified contacts reported near a monitored frontier route.
Reports are known to the responsible Starfleet command.
examples.possible_tasking: Assign a suitable available vessel to patrol and verify the reports.
examples.not_allowed: Spawn a hostile Klingon or Romulan vessel solely because a patrol mission was desired.

world_state: A civilian freighter exists in live state with propulsion failure.
Its distress signal has been detected and authenticated.
examples.possible_tasking: Divert a capable nearby unit or assign a dedicated responder.

world_state: A route segment is low-confidence or stale in the current chart database.
Starfleet has a reason to improve navigational confidence in that area.
examples.possible_tasking: Survey the route, update hazards and submit chart data.

world_state: A recognized diplomatic delegation needs transport to a valid destination.
The transport need is known to the issuing authority.
examples.possible_tasking: Assign an appropriate vessel without requiring a famous canon ship or character.
